name: Cordless Stick Vacuum
definition: A battery-powered household dry vacuum built around a handheld motor-and-bin unit that connects to a wand, floor head and task tools.
includedScope: Models supplied with motorized floor heads, removable or integrated batteries, and optional charging stations
excludedScope: Corded stick vacuums and handheld-only vacuums
Wet floor washers, carpet extractors and commercial backpack vacuums
Unverified cross-family batteries, chargers, filters or heads
primaryApplications: Pet hair and quick-response household cleaning
headline: Cordless stick vacuum systems, runtime, filtration and buyer checks
description: This profile separates battery and charger, airflow path, filtration, cleaning heads and test conditions so buyers can compare cordless stick vacuums without treating headline runtime or suction as a complete result.
metaDescription: Cordless stick vacuum guide covering batteries, runtime, suction, filtration, floor heads, models, standards and buyer verification.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not operating, electrical, battery, allergy or surface-care advice. Confirm the exact regional model, manual, battery, charger, floor head, filters, consumables and approved surfaces before procurement or use.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.value: Battery-powered household dry vacuum with wand and floor head
keyFacts.evidence: Official pages identify cordless stick or handstick systems with floor-cleaning heads.
keyFacts.scope: Named household products; wet-cleaning machines are excluded.

keyFacts.label: Runtime boundary
keyFacts.value: Runtime depends on mode, head, battery state and test method
keyFacts.evidence: Manufacturer runtime claims carry product-specific conditions such as hand-vacuum mode, minimum power or non-motorized tools.
keyFacts.scope: Source-specific conditions; values are not normalized here.

keyFacts.label: Performance method
keyFacts.value: IEC 62885-2:2026 includes cordless dry-vacuum performance methods
keyFacts.evidence: IEC states that the edition covers mains and cordless household dry vacuums and provides cordless measurement requirements.
keyFacts.scope: Covered tests and products; not every catalogue claim cites the standard.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match exact model, battery, charger, head, filters and consumables
keyFacts.evidence: Reviewed products use model-specific energy, filtration and tool architectures.
keyFacts.scope: Exact regional product code and delivered kit.

systemFlow.name: Energy storage
systemFlow.componentFamily: Battery pack, protection electronics and charger
systemFlow.role: Supplies controlled DC power and defines charging and runtime boundaries.
systemFlow.evidence: Official sources identify battery-powered products and charging arrangements.

systemFlow.name: Air movement
systemFlow.role: Creates airflow and pressure difference through the connected cleaning path.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturers publish product-specific motor, suction or control-mode claims.

systemFlow.name: Dirt separation
systemFlow.componentFamily: Cyclone or separator, bin and pre-filter
systemFlow.role: Separates and stores debris before final exhaust filtration.
systemFlow.evidence: Official pages describe bins, cyclone separation or multi-stage filtration.

systemFlow.name: Pickup path
systemFlow.componentFamily: Wand, seals, floor head and tools
systemFlow.role: Transfers airflow to the selected surface and agitates where a powered head is fitted.
systemFlow.evidence: Official kits list model-specific heads and attachments.
systemFlow.scope: Delivered regional kit; no visual-fit inference.

systemFlow.name: Exhaust and maintenance
systemFlow.componentFamily: Final filter, bin-emptying and optional station
systemFlow.role: Controls exhaust and defines routine cleaning or replacement work.
systemFlow.evidence: Reviewed products describe washable filters, retention systems or emptying stations.

variants.name: Convertible handstick
variants.operatorRelationship: User carries the motor-and-bin unit and changes tools
variants.spaceConstraints: Hand weight, reach, storage and charger position
variants.limitations: Low total weight does not establish balanced handling.
variants.evidence: Reviewed products convert between stick and handheld arrangements.

variants.name: Station-assisted system
variants.taskScale: Frequent cleaning with charging and optional bin emptying
variants.operatorRelationship: User docks the vacuum and services station consumables
variants.spaceConstraints: Dock footprint, power outlet and clearance
variants.limitations: A station does not make every maintenance step automatic.
variants.evidence: Samsung and LG describe station-integrated systems.

variants.name: Shared-battery platform
variants.taskScale: Households already using a compatible manufacturer battery family
variants.operatorRelationship: User manages charge rotation and pack identity
variants.limitations: A family name does not prove compatibility with every vacuum or charger.
variants.evidence: Bosch publishes the reviewed cordless model within its battery platform.

performanceMetrics.name: Runtime
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Available cleaning time before recharge or battery change
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Mode, head, battery capacity, surface and battery age affect the result
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not compare maximum runtime without matched conditions.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official claims state differing runtime conditions.

performanceMetrics.name: Air performance or suction claim
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Units, inlet position, tool state, mode and method differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Air watts or pascals alone do not prove floor pickup.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Manufacturer claims use model-specific methods and caveats.

performanceMetrics.name: Dust pickup
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Removal of standardized material from a stated surface
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Surface, debris, head, strokes and laboratory conditions matter
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Prefer matched IEC-method results over marketing adjectives.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IEC defines household dry-vacuum performance methods.

performanceMetrics.name: Mass and handling
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Operator load during floor and above-floor work
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Handheld body, ready-to-use and packaged weights are different
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Confirm the stated configuration and center of mass in a trial.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Samsung and Miele publish configuration-specific weights.

performanceMetrics.name: Filtration claim
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Declared containment or retention under a stated test
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Particle size, method, seals, filter condition and emptying path matter
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: A filter-media label is not whole-machine emissions performance.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official sources state product-specific filtration systems and methods.

applicationFit.assessment: A witnessed trial should use the actual surfaces, debris and supplied head.

applicationFit.limitations: No universal pickup ranking is provided.

applicationFit.evidence: Official products are positioned for multiple household floor types.

applicationFit.assessment: Handheld weight, grip, tool retention and reach should be tried by intended users.

applicationFit.limitations: Catalogue mass does not establish ergonomic suitability.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Trial the complete tool path at representative heights and durations.
applicationFit.evidence: Manufacturers describe handheld conversion and above-floor tools.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Test hair pickup, brush wrap, bin emptying and filter cleaning as one cycle.
applicationFit.assessment: Test hair pickup, brush wrap, bin emptying and filter cleaning as one cycle.
applicationFit.basis: Pet-positioned heads and anti-tangle features remain product-specific.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Use representative hair and document cleaning time after each run.
applicationFit.evidence: Official pages position selected tools or variants for hair management.

componentStack.role: Stores and restores energy for the exact appliance.
componentStack.evidence: Official pages identify model-specific battery and charging arrangements.
componentStack.scope: Family labels do not establish cross-model compatibility.

componentStack.role: Generates and regulates the air path.
componentStack.evidence: Official sources describe manual and automatic control approaches.

componentStack.role: Separates debris, stores dust and controls exhaust.
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturers publish product-specific separation and filtration designs.

componentStack.role: Connects the handheld body to floor and task tools.
componentStack.evidence: Official kits show model-specific connection systems.

componentStack.name: Floor head and tools
componentStack.role: Presents airflow and optional powered agitation to the surface.
componentStack.evidence: Official pages list different head and tool configurations.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Pickup and handling with the delivered head
procurementDecisions.assessment: Require a matched-surface trial with representative debris.
procurementDecisions.basis: The complete head, airflow and mode determine the observed result.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No normalized cross-brand result is supplied.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Record debris mass, passes, mode, runtime and hair wrap.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm approved surfaces and brush maintenance.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official products use different heads and control modes.

procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Using maximum no-load or low-mode runtime as route capacity
procurementDecisions.assessment: Time the actual route with the intended head and mode.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Battery aging and temperature remain site-specific.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Trial from full charge and set a replacement-pack policy.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Verify pack, charger and storage instructions.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Manufacturers qualify runtime by configuration or mode.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Availability and price of batteries, filters, bins, heads and brushes
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming a platform name guarantees future or cross-model spares
procurementDecisions.assessment: Attach a five-year consumables and replacement schedule to the quote.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain written part numbers, lead times and warranty terms.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Check charger-region and battery transport requirements.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official kits and support documents distinguish product-specific parts.
procurementDecisions.scope: Sales market and exact serial family.

engineeringChecks.reason: Incorrect packs or chargers can create performance and safety risks.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Match every battery and charger part number to the manual and regional product.
engineeringChecks.evidence: IEC covers battery-operated household vacuums while manufacturers define exact systems.

engineeringChecks.reason: Leaks or loaded filters change airflow and containment.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Inspect seals and document filter cleaning, drying and replacement intervals.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official sources describe multi-stage filters and maintenance-dependent systems.

engineeringChecks.reason: Brush action and clearance differ across flooring and rugs.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Obtain surface-maker approval and trial the exact head on representative areas.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Manufacturer kits use different powered heads and modes.

engineeringChecks.reason: Sound power and sound pressure values depend on setup and method.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Request the test standard, mode, head and measurement quantity before comparing.
engineeringChecks.evidence: IEC 60704-2-1:2026 defines airborne-noise methods for mains and cordless dry vacuums.

standards.name: IEC 62885-2:2026
standards.applicability: Performance measurement methods for covered mains and cordless household dry vacuum cleaners.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the scope and cordless Annex D boundary.
standards.scope: Compare only values produced under matched methods and conditions.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-2:2026
standards.applicability: Safety requirements for covered household vacuum cleaners, including battery-operated appliances and associated motorized heads.
standards.scope: Confirm regional adoption and exact product conformity.

standards.name: IEC 60704-2-1:2026
standards.applicability: Particular methods for airborne acoustical noise of covered household dry vacuums, including cordless products and docking stations.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the product and measurement scope.
standards.scope: Sound quantity and setup must match.

developments.evidence: IEC records the publication date and scope.
